Ayurveda research methodology textbook launched for scholars

A new textbook on research methodology specifically designed for postgraduate and PhD scholars in Ayurveda has been launched. The initiative aims to promote scientific writing and research skills within the Ayurvedic academic community. This development is intended to enhance the quality and rigor of Ayurvedic research.
